$$
0 \longrightarrow \mathbb{Z}/10 \longrightarrow \mathbb{Z}/100 \longrightarrow \mathbb{Z}/10 \longrightarrow 0
$$

A week-long class from Mathcamp 2019 based on a fun paper by Dan Isaksen titled
[A cohomological viewpoint on elementary school arithmetic](https://www.jstor.org/stable/3072368?seq=1).
It introduces group extensions and exact sequences as a way to interpret the addition of
multi-digit numbers.

It is designed in an IBL format. The prerequisites are group theory.
